newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products steady to firmer, bar gas oil.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products steady to firmer, bar gas oil.

text.p: NWE oil products were firmer on Friday bar easier gas oil.
Spot gas oil prices were slightly weaker with bench IPE gas oil moving lower in correction to Thursday's gains and slack buying interest putting barge and cargo premiums under pressure.

Prompt and early August lifting barges were assessed flat with buying notionally around Aug evens to +25 cents and selling at 50 cents to +$1 fob ARA. Storage material was valued 50 cents to $1 under refinery oil.
Diesel barge premiums eased 50 cents to Aug +$4/$5 fob.
High sulphur fuel oil barges rose a little to $89 an $90 fob for storage and refinery product respectively. High sulphur cargoes were quiet but assessed steady with swaps a little higher.
Gasoline was steady to a touch firmer with tightish supplies and strong U.S. numbers keeping the market going.
